mood: Authoritative, razor-sharp, technically profound, reliable, 'Control Room' vibe

headings.usage: H1, H2, Dashboard widget titles. (DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans)

mono.usage: Logs, code snippets, metrics, data points

hierarchy.subtitle: text-xl sm:text-2xl (Must not be more than 2 steps smaller than heading)
hierarchy.widget_title: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#A0A0A0]
hierarchy.metric: text-3xl md:text-5xl font-mono tracking-tighter text-white font-bold

portfolio_landing.grid: MODE A: 'TETRIS' Grid (Asymmetric, wide gaps). Ensure not fully filled to leave negative space.

dashboards.grid: MODE B: 'CONTROL ROOM' Grid (High density, pure utility, gap-4 md:gap-6).
dashboards.structure: Grid Borders: container uses border-collapse layout, items have subtle 1px right/bottom borders in #222222.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid #121212, 1px solid #222222 border, max rounded-md, no soft shadows.
surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70, 1px bottom border-white/10. MUST be z-50.
surfaces.inputs: Neumorphism/Tactile strict variant. Deep #0A0A0A background, 1px #333 border, focus ring 2px #00E5FF.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top bar, z-50. Must include Logo, cross-project links (Sentinel-Ops, RootCause-AI), and primary CTA.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm). Primary: bg-[#00E5FF] text-black font-bold. Critical: bg-[#FF3366] text-white. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#222222] text-white.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts library. Dark mode tooltips (bg-[#121212] border-[#222222]). Line/Bar colors mapped to Brand Accents.
components_strategy.log_viewer: Terminal/Retro-Futurism vibe. Deep #000000 bg, JetBrains Mono font, colorful syntax highlighting (cyan, red, green).
components_strategy.chat_panel: Right-aligned fixed panel or Shadcn Sheet. Minimalist, high-density chat bubbles. Dropdown for Model Picker.
components_strategy.rca_output_card: Grid Border style with high contrast. Use red/yellow badges for Severity. Clearly separate 'Probable Cause' and 'Suggested Fix'.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Interactive elements shift background to #1A1A1A, text to #FFFFFF. Add '-translate-y-1' to cards.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Focus states mandatory: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF]. Use proper aria-labels.
motion_and_interaction.data_testid: ALL interactive/key elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'nav-sentinel-link', 'analyze-logs-button').

icons_and_assets.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) or lucide-react (default). Keep lines sharp and technical.

images.description: Dynamic red neon lights and geometric patterns. Use as the hero section background on the landing page with heavy bg-black/70 overlay to ensure text contrast.
Cyberpunk digital numbers. Use as a subtle atmospheric background layer for RootCause-AI or the portfolio's tech stack section.

icons_and_assets.logos: Do NOT use placeholder images for tech stack/logos. Use typography-based tags in JetBrains Mono with 1px borders (e.g., [ React ] [ Python ]).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this file carefully and strictly adhere to the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' dark theme.
2. Install required fonts (Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) from Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
3. Use pure Tailwind CSS for structural grid layouts (avoid using Shadcn layout cards if they break the grid asymmetry).
4. Create 3 distinct views/routes: Portfolio Landing (/), Sentinel-Ops (/sentinel), and RootCause-AI (/rootcause).
5. Use Recharts for Sentinel-Ops live telemetry. Mock the data with intervals so charts appear alive.
6. RootCause-AI must have a massive, visually imposing text area for dumping stack traces, followed by an analytical Grid Border response card.
7. Implement all interactive states explicitly (hover, focus, active).
9. Include a multi-model selector (Claude 4.5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro) in both AI apps.
